_help: Act 2, Yacoub Ben-Ami's office in the old quarter: recruiting Dr. Hassan al-Masri (hired_hassan). The reliable fallback: he joins even if you can't pay. His secret (character.md): conviction is his resolve to protect the tomb; refusing his promise or talking treasure (hassan_heard_greed) is remembered. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: hassan
already.line: My books are packed. The ones I kept, at least.

yacoub.speaker: yacoub
yacoub.line: An expedition to Akmentar? Then you want the doctor, not me. He is in the back room, as always, arguing with his books.

again.speaker: hassan
again.line: You came back. Most people who ask about Akmentar do not.

first.speaker: hassan
first.line: Akmentar. Few people say the name aloud, and fewer say it seriously. Sit down. Tell me why you want to go there.

choices.label: For the treasure
choices.line: There's a king's gold out there, and someone's going to take it.

choices.label: For the job
choices.line: I'm paid to get people there and back. That's all.

choices.label: To see what's really there
choices.line: Because someone tried very hard to make the world forget it. I want to know why.

legend.speaker: hassan
legend.line: A king the priests struck from every wall, and a tomb they built so that no one would ever open it. Ask yourself why a people who loved so much to be remembered worked so hard to forget.

greed.speaker: hassan
greed.line: Honest, at least. Gold has buried more men than the desert.

curious.speaker: hassan
curious.line: Then we share a question, if not yet an answer.

offer.speaker: hassan
offer.line: I will come. My fee is small: thirty pounds, for the books I had to sell. And one promise. When I say a door should stay closed, you will at least listen.

choices.label: Promise and pay
choices.line: Thirty pounds, and I'll listen. You have my word.

choices.label: Promise, but no money
choices.line: I can't pay you yet. But I'll listen.

choices.label: Pay, but no promises
choices.line: Thirty pounds. The doors are my decision.

joined.speaker: hassan
joined.line: Good. Then we shall see what kind of man leads this expedition.

joined_poor.speaker: hassan
joined_poor.line: Keep your money. I have waited thirty years to see that place. I can wait a little longer for thirty pounds.

joined_cool.speaker: hassan
joined_cool.line: Then I shall have to find other ways of being heard.
